summary: The coordinate-only certainty rules are sufficient for the stated conservative historical-face provenance claims. They do not reconstruct the old foreground, recover a Query, or identify which compatible superpoint was selected. No concrete source defect found.

checks.information_sufficiency: For a valid old mask-range face, at least one selected raw member attained that extremum. The helper takes a conservative superset of every raw point coordinate-compatible within2e-6m. If all candidates are background, any actual extremal member must be background. If all candidate source superpoints are pure background, any actual source must be pure background. Target/background ties remain ambiguous. Possible mixed sources alone do not imply old selection.
checks.no_fresh_prediction_dependency: historical_faces reads only xyz, target, superpoint and root_gt from the fresh archive; its face coordinates and annotation Query index come from cached historical records. No fresh mask, score, Query feature or fresh reference box affects the result. Both current_masks_used and historical_foreground_reconstructed are false.
checks.old_extent_and_tolerance: The unchanged valid mask reference is the min/max of actual superpoint members. All191 bound cached references are valid, and their stored centers/sizes are exactly float32-representable. Minimum size is0.01806473731994629m, so the1e-6 native size floor does not alter these faces. Using the declared float32 center=(low+high)/2 and size=high-low arithmetic, the largest half-center-ULP plus quarter-size-ULP face reconstruction bound is2.39349901676178e-7m, below the fixed2e-6m matching tolerance. Every actual row still must have nonempty coordinate candidates at execution.
checks.real_gt_and_identity: Target labels are the actual dataset object member indices, not predicted-mask labels. The previously reviewed collector enforces exact historical XYZRGB identity, scene/target identity and rootGT before saving its arrays. This supplement rechecks the historical point identity, intake NPZ bytes/SHA and exact rootGT, then counts target/background members and complete superpoint purity from those archived labels.
checks.missing_face_diagnosis: Observed target members beyond each old face are counted directly in the raw coordinates, with the same fixed tolerance. Signed GT-box extent and observed-member support remain separate. A missing GT face without observed target members beyond it is explicitly an input-support observation, not a universal impossibility claim.
checks.execution_and_claim_gates: Requires the existing191-case CPU summary and CLOSED_ARTIFACTS_COLLECTED/no-replay intake, then reads and verifies every bound row_ID NPZ. The manifest contains191 unique historical cases and the run asserts191 outputs. Summary explicitly excludes old Query/foreground recovery, new overall accuracy, effective-module, optimization and neural-forward claims; overlapping row categories are disclosed. No deployment logic is changed.
checks.local_source_evidence: All3 new Python files parse under Python3.7 grammar. The existing synthetic receipt records3 actual checks: pure background, coincident target/background ambiguity, and a background extremum from a mixed superpoint. Its source implements those checks. This reviewer did not rerun that checker or the actual191-case analyzer.
